glossary.definition: (1) "State institution of higher education" has the same meaning as in section 3345.011 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3345.38 - Undergraduate course credit for completion of international baccalaureate diploma program.

glossary.definition:
(2) "International baccalaureate diploma program" means the curriculum and examinations leading to an international baccalaureate diploma awarded by the international baccalaureate organization.
